learning_outcomes.text: Explains the basic principles, operating principles, and application areas of heating and ventilation systems.
Explains the functions and operating principles of basic heating and ventilation components such as boilers, heaters, pumps, fans, piping, and duct systems.
Determines the heating load of buildings and the required ventilation airflow rate, and performs basic heating and ventilation calculations.
Selects appropriate heating and ventilation systems for different applications and performs basic system design and sizing.
Evaluates heating and ventilation systems in terms of energy efficiency, indoor air quality, thermal comfort, and environmental sustainability.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to heating and ventilation; basic concepts, applications, and operating principles of systems
Heat losses and basic principles of heating load calculations
Heating load calculation; heat losses through building components and design conditions
Classification of heating systems; hot-water, steam, and warm-air heating systems
Boilers and heaters; types, operating principles, capacity, and selection criteria
Pumps and piping systems; pipe sizing, pressure losses, and pump selection
Basic design and sizing of heating systems; example system applications
Basic principles of ventilation; ventilation requirements, air change rates, and ventilation airflow rates
Indoor air quality and thermal comfort; determination of ventilation requirements
Natural and mechanical ventilation systems; operating principles and applications
Fans and air ducts; fan selection, duct sizing, and pressure losses
Air distribution systems; diffusers, grilles, and basic principles of air distribution
Energy efficiency, energy conservation, and sustainable applications in heating and ventilation systems
Integrated evaluation of heating and ventilation systems; example system design, performance, and comfort assessment
